case_number: 2025 INSC 129; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 [Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 7660 of 2017]

parties.petitioner: Smt. N. Usha Rani and Anr.

summary: Maintenance under Section 125 CrPC to second wife during subsistence of first marriage; conflicting precedents examined—Vimala and Dwarika Prasad favor purposive interpretation requiring proof of first marriage; Yamunabai and Savitaben adopt strict legality; Chanmuniya recognizes social justice but refers question to larger bench; standard of proof in maintenance proceedings less stringent than in criminal trials; emphasis on preventing vagrancy and destitution; de facto marriages considered for maintenance if first marriage not strictly proved.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.498A, s.406, s.506, s.420
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; maintenance to appellant no.1 restored, subject to determination of subsistence of first marriage with strict proof; matter remanded for reconsideration consistent with the principles of social justice and purposive interpretation.
